title: Percentage Increase and Decrease
seo_title: Grade 7 Percentage Increase and Decrease Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 7)
standard_text: Solve problems involving: a. percentage increase, and b. percentage decrease.
meta_desc: Free Grade 7 percentage increase and decrease worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: multipliers, percentage change, original amounts and word problems with pesos. 100 questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Percentage change = change ÷ original amount × 100%.
  • To increase by 15%, multiply by 1.15 (100% + 15%). To decrease by 15%, multiply by 0.85 (100% − 15%).
  • To find the original amount, divide the new amount by the multiplier.
  • Always compare the change with the original amount.

Examples

Example

₱50 to ₱60

change ₱10

10 ÷ 50 × 100

Answer: 20% increase

Example

₱680 after a 15% decrease

680 ÷ 0.85

Answer: ₱800 originally

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Dividing by the new amountDivide the change by the original amount.
Stopping at the changeAdd or subtract the change to get the new amount.
Undoing with the same percentA 20% increase is not undone by a 20% decrease.
